description: Executable evals for the technical-writing skill. Verifies (a) a comment request produces a why/intent comment rather than a restatement of the code, and (b) a doc-prose request fires the skill and engages its style vocabulary.
_contract_note: skill_invoked is kept diagnostic-tier: plain-English triggers do not reliably re-emit the Skill tool call in --print transcripts (same channel-reliability rationale as the adr/sdr suites). The load-bearing required signal is a content regex — for the comment eval, the intent vocabulary the prompt supplies (a why-comment MUST surface it; a what-comment cannot). The restatement not_regex is diagnostic because failure phrasing varies. Not a HARD-GATE skill, so <4 structural assertions is acceptable per ADR #0005.

evals.name: comment-explains-why-not-what
evals.summary: Guards the core rule: a comment request surfaces the supplied intent (per-batch budget), not a restatement of `retries = 0`. This is the primary discriminating signal — the prompt hands the model the 'why', so a rule-following answer includes it and a lazy what-comment omits it.
evals.prompt: Here's a line from our batch processor: `retries = 0`. It sits at the top of each batch because the retry budget is per-batch, not per-item. Write the code comment that should go above this line.

assertions.description: diagnostic: skill_invoked channel — plain-English re-emit is unreliable per adr/sdr suite rationale; informational only
required: the comment surfaces the WHY the prompt supplied (per-batch retry budget) — the load-bearing signal separating an intent comment from a restatement
diagnostic negative: forbids a pure restatement comment ('set retries to zero') — the failure mode the why-not-what rule prevents

evals.name: fires-on-doc-prose-request
evals.summary: A README-writing request fires the skill and engages its style guidance. Required-tier regex on skill engagement vocabulary; skill_invoked stays diagnostic for channel parity with adr/sdr.
evals.prompt: Write a short 'Configure the webhook' section for our API README, explaining how a user points the service at their endpoint URL.

assertions.description: diagnostic: skill_invoked channel — informational only per re-emit reliability note

required: response either announces the technical-writing skill or applies second-person/active-voice prose ('you point the service at...') — engagement signal distinguishing rule-following output from a generic dump
